_about: Public facts for the Hearthside case study on the marketing portfolio. Copied from the other portfolio and reworded for this site.
name: Hearthside
one_line: Conversion-focused websites for UK home care providers: a fixed-price site live in 7 working days, with optional monthly plans that automate enquiry follow-up and carer recruitment.
status: Pre-launch. Started 22 Nov 2026. No clients, no revenue and nothing sent or published yet.
role: Founder: chose the market, niche, offer and name; directed and reviewed all the work.

market.home_care_services_england: roughly 12,000 to 16,000 depending on the source
market.growth_since_2019: about 42% more homecare services on the CQC register (Apr 2019 to Apr 2026)

pipeline.label: CQC-regulated locations in the public directory (19 Nov 2026)
independent home care agencies with a website
websites fetched and scored by a Python script for 13 signs of age
most dated, with CQC rating and registration checked
read page by page to confirm contact details
qualified prospects across 10 UK regions (39 from the pipeline plus 5 found by hand)

outreach.why_split: UK PECR rules: limited companies can be emailed without consent; sole traders and partnerships cannot.
outreach.sequence: Four emails over 14 days with a phone call on day 5

features: Offer and price above the fold
SEO basics: titles, structured data, sitemap
Accessibility basics: skip link, keyboard focus, labelled fields, reduced motion

emails.format: Email-safe HTML, 600px, table layout, with plain-text versions
